query.rationale: The tool can `Run a read-only SQL query`, so it can return data from a PostgreSQL database reached with the user's configured access; database contents may be non-public, so SECRET applies. The advertised text does not say the database is single-writer or otherwise trusted; SQL query results can include content from multi-writer application tables or other attacker-authored rows, so under the least restrictive reading UNTRUSTED applies, but this is undetermined from the description. It is described as `read-only`, with no agent-chosen URL/host or write/post/send capability, so it is not a SINK or HOSTEXEC based on the advertised text.
